data.narrative:
Second Front Systems is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $90M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x to the $90M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $171M. Peer-median analysis across six same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The median peer reflects the 1.4B Harmattan AI, 1.2B Code Metal, and the 1.0B positions of Defense Unicorns and Heven AeroTech.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $145M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $648M. The substantial gap between methods reflects material uncertainty around Second Front's positioning within the peer cohort. The stage-progression approach anchors conservatively to deployment capital; the peer-median method reflects market pricing of comparable-stage operators in an active defense-tech segment. Key uncertainties include whether Second Front's product differentiation, customer traction, and capital efficiency align it toward the lower-quartile or median peer valuations within this wide range.
